svg.title: State machine: OAuth token
svg.desc: 5 states and 7 numbered transitions of the oauth token lifecycle, with the guard or timing of each transition listed below.

g.aria-label: T1: Not connected → Authorising – connect: state in sessionStorage, PKCE verifier in Redis (TTL 600 s)
g.title: T1: Not connected → Authorising – connect: state in sessionStorage, PKCE verifier in Redis (TTL 600 s)

g.aria-label: T2: Authorising → Connected – callback validates state, exchanges code, stores token (default_user)
g.title: T2: Authorising → Connected – callback validates state, exchanges code, stores token (default_user)

g.aria-label: T3: Authorising → Not connected – state expired or error: redirect after 3000 ms; musicLibrary PKCE link > 900 s
g.title: T3: Authorising → Not connected – state expired or error: redirect after 3000 ms; musicLibrary PKCE link > 900 s

g.aria-label: T4: Connected → Refreshing – checked every 60 s; 5 min before expiry (default lifetime 3600 s)
g.title: T4: Connected → Refreshing – checked every 60 s; 5 min before expiry (default lifetime 3600 s)

g.aria-label: T5: Refreshing → Connected – refresh under navigator.locks (localStorage mutex fallback)
g.title: T5: Refreshing → Connected – refresh under navigator.locks (localStorage mutex fallback)

g.aria-label: T7: Expired → Not connected – user signs in again
g.title: T7: Expired → Not connected – user signs in again

g.text: Not connected → Authorising: connect: state in sessionStorage, PKCE verifier in Redis (TTL 600 s)
Authorising → Connected: callback validates state, exchanges code, stores token (default_user)
Authorising → Not connected: state expired or error: redirect after 3000 ms; musicLibrary PKCE link > 900 s
Connected → Refreshing: checked every 60 s; 5 min before expiry (default lifetime 3600 s)
Refreshing → Connected: refresh under navigator.locks (localStorage mutex fallback)
Expired → Not connected: user signs in again
Transition (badge T = row in the transition list)
